name: Advanced Dynamics & Multibody Systems
summary: Three-dimensional rigid-body dynamics and the analytical methods used to model and simulate complex machines, vehicles and robots.

topics.name: Rotation representations: rotation matrices, Euler angles, axis-angle, quaternions
Angular velocity and acceleration in 3D; rotating reference frames
Inertia tensor, principal axes and Euler's equations
Gyroscopic effects, spinning tops and gyroscopes
Generalised coordinates, holonomic and nonholonomic constraints, virtual work
Kane's method and recursive Newton-Euler formulations
Multibody system formulations and constraint stabilisation
Contact, impact and friction in multibody simulation
Numerical multibody simulation tools (Simscape Multibody, MSC Adams, MuJoCo)
